Gina (CS): Morning — quick weekly token/throughput snapshot for Summit account.
Gina (CS): QoQ: +12% token volume, WoW: -7% (weekend dip). Peak TPS moved ~20m earlier.
Gina (CS): Latency: p50 ~90ms, p95 spiked to ~320ms during incident window; overall median up from 95ms -> 120ms QoQ.
Maya (CS): Noted. Any correlation with model/config changes or recent feature flags?
Roberto (SRE): We rolled a canary quantized VP model Tue 03:10 UTC. KV-cache miss rate jumped ~3x in that window.
Roberto (SRE): 5xx rate rose 0.2% -> 1.3% for ~45m, symptoms looked like pod OOMs; autoscaler was capped at 4 pods.
Sam (AE): Customer already pinged support — they noticed slow interactive responses. Asking for timeline on mitigation.
Gina (CS): Spend is +18% MoM vs forecast, driven by regen loops at p95 latency. If this persists, renewal conversation could get flagged.
Maya (CS): Can we offer a quick batching/throttle change and an enablement session for their devs to address regen loops?
Roberto (SRE): Quick actions taken: 1) rolled back canary (in progress), 2) bumped autoscaler max to 8, 3) enabled prefix-KV sticky caching for Summit route.
ingest-bot: rollback-deploy-bot: rollback completed at 1718769000. Autoscale max now 8. Telemetry window open 30m.
Gina (CS): Please share a 30m token/latency snapshot and a short blurb Sam can send to the customer.
Roberto (SRE): Early numbers after changes: p95 trending down to ~140ms, 5xx back to ~0.25%. Will upload full 30m report.
Sam (AE): I'll draft the customer note: mention rollback, autoscale bump, and offer 1-hr enablement. Will post to #customer-comms for review.
Maya (CS): I'll schedule enablement Tue next week and prepare a short prompt guide to reduce regen calls.
Gina (CS): Follow-ups: @Roberto upload 30m report, @Maya schedule enablement, @Sam send comms. I'll set renewal risk to 'watch' and add to Friday exec sync.
Roberto (SRE): Uploaded 30m report: https://telemetry.redwood/summit/1718765432/30m-report (link)
Sam (AE): Draft shared in #customer-comms, requesting approvals. :thumbsup:
Gina (CS): Thanks team. I'll mark this thread resolved after Friday sync unless new issues appear.
